fusions.name: Sticky Strand
fusions.desc: Casts a sticky strand that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Ambush Drop
fusions.desc: A blow from above that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Silk Cocoon
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Threads Gathered
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
